ink.misregistration: Pink plate translate(-3px, 2px) under the blue plate at 34px to 62px type; cover wordmark at 118px uses translate(-5px, 4px).
ink.inkFilter: #ink in site/app/layout.tsx: fractal-noise displacement (baseFrequency 0.035, scale 2) roughens edges, then a 1.1 frequency grain mask knocks paper specks out of solids. For type and small solids.
ink.floodFilter: #flood in site/app/layout.tsx: slow anisotropic mottle (0.006 0.018) holds density at 92% or more, plus sparse specks. For large ink fills.
ink.paper: site/public/paper.jpg, a 1300px seamless uncoated plate tiled at 1x over the paper color.
ink.art: site/public/mic-ink.jpg, the two-ink Riso mic with paper divided out, composited with multiply. The icon and cover use the same art family (assets/src/icon-art.jpg, cover-art.jpg).

components.name: Download button
components.description: The primary action, printed as pink and blue plates off register with the label knocked out to paper. Hover pulls the plates toward register; press lands them.
components.css: .ds-download { position: relative; display: inline-block; isolation: isolate; padding: 18px 34px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--paper-light, #f8f3eb); font: 800 21px/1.2 "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-download::before, .ds-download::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; mix-blend-mode: multiply; } .ds-download::before { background: var(--pink, #ed269d); transform: translate(-3px, 2px); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1); } .ds-download::after { background: var(--blue, #1c81c3); } .ds-download:hover::before { transform: translate(-1px, 1px); } .ds-download:active::before { transform: none; } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1c81c3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav-download { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--purple, #4a147d); color: var(--paper-light, #f8f3eb); font: 600 16px/1.55 "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-download:hover { background: #3b0f66; } .ds-nav-download:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1c81c3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 22px 20px; background: var(--paper, #f2eadf); color: var(--purple, #4a147d); font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { position: relative; display: inline-block; text-decoration: none; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; } .ds-plate { mix-blend-mode: multiply; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-plate-pink { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; color: var(--pink, #ed269d); transform: translate(-3px, 2px); } .ds-plate-blue { position: relative; color: var(--blue, #1c81c3); } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-plate-pink { transform: translate(-5px, 3px); } .ds-masthead nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; } .ds-masthead nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline 2px transparent; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-masthead nav a:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--pink, #ed269d); } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1c81c3); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-callout { display: flex; flex-direction: row-reverse; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; max-width: 460px; font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--purple, #4a147d); } .ds-callout polyline { fill: none; stroke: var(--blue, #1c81c3); stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: stroke 160ms ease-out, stroke-width 160ms ease-out; } .ds-pin { fill: var(--paper-light, #f8f3eb); stroke: var(--blue, #1c81c3); stroke-width: 2.5; transition: stroke 160ms ease-out; } .ds-pin-dot { fill: var(--blue, #1c81c3); transition: fill 160ms ease-out; } .ds-callout h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; text-align: right; transition: color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-callout p { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--purple-2, #5f3f80); text-align: right; } .ds-callout:hover h3 { color: var(--pink, #ed269d); } .ds-callout:hover polyline { stroke: var(--pink, #ed269d); stroke-width: 3; } .ds-callout:hover .ds-pin { stroke: var(--pink, #ed269d); } .ds-callout:hover .ds-pin-dot { fill: var(--pink, #ed269d); }

components.css: .ds-facts { position: relative; isolation: isolate; margin: 0; padding: 14px 26px; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--purple, #4a147d); } .ds-facts::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--blue, #1c81c3) 0.75px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4px 4px; opacity: 0.4; mix-blend-mode: multiply; } .ds-facts div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8.5em 1fr; gap: 16px; padding-block: 14px; border-top: 1.5px solid rgba(74, 20, 125, 0.35); } .ds-facts div:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-facts dt { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; }

components.css: .ds-flood { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 200px; padding: 48px 40px; transform: rotate(0.5deg); font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-flood::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--blue, #1c81c3); mix-blend-mode: multiply; } .ds-flood p { margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; color: var(--paper-light, #f8f3eb); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-caret { display: inline-block; width: 3px; height: 1.05em; margin-left: 3px; vertical-align: -0.15em; background: var(--pink, #ed269d); animation: ds-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-caret { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-faq { border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--blue, #1c81c3); font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", var(--font-bricolage), "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--purple, #4a147d); } .ds-faq details { border-top: 1.5px solid var(--blue, #1c81c3); } .ds-faq summary { position: relative; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 22px 48px 22px 0; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary::before, .ds-faq summary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; width: 18px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--pink, #ed269d); transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-faq summary::after { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-faq details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(0deg); } .ds-faq summary:hover { color: #3b0f66; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1c81c3); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-faq p { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; padding-bottom: 24px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--purple-2, #5f3f80); }

narrative.overview:
Every Closetalk surface is a sheet that came off a Risograph. There is one paper, uncoated and warm with visible fiber, and two inks: fluorescent pink and blue. Wherever the two overprint they make a deep purple, and that purple carries the reading text. Nothing on the page claims to be a screen. Type has a slightly rough edge, solids carry specks of paper showing through, flat plates sit a fraction of a degree crooked, and the two plates of a wordmark or heading land a few pixels out of register.

The landing page, the app icon and the README cover all print this same job. The hero is a labeled product diagram: the Riso mic in the middle, thin blue leader lines running from round pins on the mic to short callouts at its sides. That diagram language (leader, pin, callout) belongs to the world and may return on future surfaces. The page is light and generous: a single centered column, large heavy Grotesque headlines, plain paragraphs, and long breaks between sections.

The page stays print in every system theme. It declares `color-scheme: light` and never inverts.
keyCharacteristics: One paper ground, two inks, purple only where they overprint.
Ink is simulated with the `#ink` filter (rough edge, paper specks) on type and small solids, and the `#flood` filter (uneven drum density) on large fills.
Pink and blue plates combine with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, never with opacity.
Misregistration of 3px left and 2px down is the signature gesture.
Hand-fed sheets: tint and flood plates rotate by about half a degree.
Bricolage Grotesque for everything, at 500, 600 and 800.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Only pink and blue are inks. Purple exists because they overprint, so a new hue never enters. A third ink would break the print.

rules.name: The Multiply Rule
rules.body: Ink on paper always composites with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. Layered plates darken where they meet, the way real ink does. Opacity fades and normal blending are off-world.

rules.name: The Knockout Rule
rules.body: Text on a solid ink plate is paper showing through (paper-light), never white and never a third color.

rules.name: The Heavy Print Rule
rules.body: Headings and anything printed in ink set at 800. Weight 700 is for fact terms, questions and flood text, 600 for navigation and fact values, 500 for reading text. Nothing goes lighter than 500.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Rule
rules.body: The face ships from the site's own origin. No runtime request reaches a font CDN.

rules.name: The Misregistration Rule
rules.body: A two-plate print offsets its pink plate 3px left and 2px down from the blue plate (at 34px to 62px type; scale it with size, as the cover does at 118px with 5px and 4px). This is ink, not a shadow. Hover may pull the plates toward register (the Download button closes to 1px, then 0 on press; the wordmark drifts apart to 5px and 3px).

rules.name: The Crooked Sheet Rule
rules.body: Tint and flood plates sit slightly rotated, between -0.6deg and 0.5deg, like a hand-fed sheet. Type plates stay square.

dos: Do print headings, the wordmark and primary actions as two plates, pink offset 3px left and 2px down under blue, both multiplied.
Do set reading text in Overprint Purple (purple) and secondary text in Thin Purple (purple-2) on Uncoated Paper.
Do run large ink fills through `#flood` and type or small solids through `#ink`, so solids show grain.
Do knock text out of ink plates to Bright Paper (paper-light).
Do use blue for structure (lines, rules, pins, focus) and pink for emphasis and live states.
Do keep the page light in every system theme and serve fonts and images from the site's own origin.
donts: Don't introduce a third ink, a gradient, or a dark theme.
Don't add box shadows or glows to web surfaces; depth comes from overprint and misregistration.
Don't fade ink with opacity or stack plates with normal blending; use multiply.
Don't set type lighter than 500 or swap in a second typeface.
Don't rotate type plates; only tint and flood plates sit crooked.
